On this day, the 1st day of July, 2003, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have met for the purpose of discussing and passing a resolution, for the amending of the Official Policy for the Treutlen County Rural Fire Department.

WHEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such resolution was passed unanimously, and the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners issues the following Resolution:

WHEREFORE, that Treutlen County, Georgia, is in need of an amended to the written policy for the continued operation of the Treutlen County Rural Fire Department; and

WHEREFORE, this matter has been discussed in prior Board meetings and the Board has gained the benefit of input from various Treutlen County firemen and has determined that an amendment written policy is needed for continued effective and consistent operation of the same; therefore

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners hereby passes the amendment to the Official Policy for the Treutlen County

Rural Fire Department, as attached.

On this day, the 6 day of May, 2003, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have met for the purpose of discussing and passing a resolution, for the creation of an Official Policy for the Treutlen County Rural Fire Department.

WHEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such resolution was passed unanimously, and the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners issues the following Resolution:

WHEREFORE, that Treutlen County, Georgia, is in need of an expanded written policy for the continued operation of the Treutlen County Rural Fire Department, and

WHEREFORE, this matter has been discussed in prior Board meetings and the Board has gained the benefit of input from various Treutlen County firemen and has determined that a written policy is needed for continued effective and consistent operation of the same; therefore

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners hereby pass and declare that they now have an Official Policy for the Treutlen

County Rural Fire Department.
